description: Updated exercise package for Hermes Agent Plugin v2.3.5. Uses RELATIVE paths to match the tools' path containment security model. E2E tests at 98% pass rate use relative paths. The old v1 exercises used absolute paths (/tmp) which conflict with path containment.
reason_for_update: v1 exercises used absolute paths (/tmp) causing 'Access denied' errors due to path containment. v2 uses relative paths (src/) which work correctly with the security model.
e2e_evidence: E2E tests (test-e2e.ts) use relative paths and achieve 98.0% pass rate. This proves tools work with relative paths.

how_to_use.method: Run each exercise in OpenCode using RELATIVE paths. Capture actual output. Fill EXERCISE_RESULTS.json.
how_to_use.delivery: Send completed JSON to DevOps Manager for analysis
